contract: BB37: AnnounceService.PublicName(player, honorific) = Util.PlayerDisplayName (+ Config.Announce.Text.Honorific "님" when honorific) or, when data.HideAnnounceName (attribute before the data loads), HiddenName "<faction> 한 명" (Someone "누군가" without a faction), never with an honorific; every server-wide line goes through it: PvPService MostWanted / 2x BountyAnnounce / town board (the wanted line; the weekly rows come from RankingService.ServerTop), GrudgeService GrudgeAvengedAll, ProgressionService RebirthAnnounce, GooseService RareAnnounce, KaijuService kaiju name; the five Config.Text lines use "%s이" so "OO님이" / "뿔 군단 한 명이" both read right; the SetAnnounceName handler calls RankingService.MarkHideChanged (pcall, optional); setting label '알림·랭킹에 내 이름 숨기기' + 2 notes (KO/EN). BB12: Config.Leaderstats.Columns {Power, Level, Rebirths, Fame} (gold hidden, A23-21), creation order = column order, Power = the CombatPower attribute (formula fallback before JusticeService sets it), Fame = Halo Honor / Horns Infamy / Neutral WeekArtisan (A23-24) / None 0, LEADERSTAT_KEYS watches every attribute a column reads, unknown / repeated ids skipped with a warning; changing the columns is one Config line.
limitations: Offline doubles: Players / Instances / attributes, PlayerService (data rows, SetStat mirror), ClassService, FactionService / JusticeService / CombatService / ZoneService / KaijuService / MapBuilder stand-ins for the whole PvPService. GrudgeService / ProgressionService / GooseService / KaijuService lines are checked statically plus their extracted publicName helper. The Roblox player list UI, chat rendering and 2-client checks are not certified here (the 게임성 개발 session plays them after the merge).
